dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge exhibits a deep concave spline with a significant discontinuity forming a sharp indentation/notch at the posterior base.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute shape classification with a minimal pixel radius, resulting in a sharply pointed dorsal extremity.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Linear ascending margin at approximately 55-60 degrees relative to the visible horizontal dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.4:1 ratio of maximum vertical pixel height to longitudinal base width.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Three parallel linear diagonal scars (tooth rakes) on the lateral flank; a deep, jagged V-shaped notch on the lower trailing edge of the dorsal fin; scattered white punctate lesions across the fin and body surface.
other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast light-toned saddle patch coloration present on the dorsal-lateral surface anterior to the fin base.
